lines.trans: Tell me honestly, did this sheep die of old age?
Why insult me? This is a young and tasty lamb!
I already have enough sheep in the kitchen.
Wait, look at this excellent meat!
I swear, this is the best fresh meat!
Yes, this lamb is really good.
Fine, I will take this meat.
Chef, my dear, do you need truffles?
Are you offering me contraband again?
Of course I do! How much are you selling them for?
For you as a friend, only six hundred euros per kilogram.
Great, I will take these truffles!
Then the price has risen to seven hundred euros!
Timur, don't get cheeky and hand over the goods!

examples.trans: My mood really is very good.
This is indeed an important question.

meanings.note: to a loved one, and at the start of letters

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.
Give me two kilograms of apples, please.
Three rooms and a big kitchen.

meanings.note: лучший в мире = the best in the world

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary
